summary: Full backend + frontend test of the new SPV-only features (Strategi Eksekusi: Landasan Strategis / Balanced Scorecard / Cascade View, and Manajemen User CRUD) plus regression spot-checks. Created /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (37 pytest cases): 36 passed, 1 failed (organization partial-update wipes lists). Frontend Playwright: SPV login, sidebar gating, /strategy 3 tabs, Landasan save+reload persistence, BSC goal create with 2 KPIs (progress bars 80%/40% with correct colors), goal edit + delete, Cascade View rendering (org name, vision, values badges, all 4 perspectives, counters), User Management list/create/search/edit/reset-password/delete, self-row has no Delete, new user can log in with reset password, anggota is blocked from /strategy and /users (sidebar hidden + redirect). Regression: OKR create, task create in Execution Scoreboard, Amaliyah habit toggle (with persistence after reload), SPV dashboard all OK. All QA-created data cleaned up; global organization doc restored to the owner's real content.

minor.issue: Partial payload wipes list fields. OrgIn declares mission/values with default [] (not None), so the `if v is not None` filter keeps the empty lists and $set clears them. PUT {"name":"X"} erases mission and values. Fix: make them Optional[List[str]] = None. (test_partial_update_does_not_wipe_lists)

Spec in review request says baseline=0/target=100/realisasi=40 -> 'At Risk' amber, but implemented thresholds are >=80 green, >=50 amber, else red, so 40% renders 'Off Track' red (verified in UI: bg-rose-500 bar + Off Track pill). Backend health for 40% is also 'red'. Align thresholds or the spec.
N+1 query pattern: per-workspace owner/tasks/okrs/habits/habit_logs queries inside a loop. Works now, will degrade with more workspaces.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing data-testid on KPI numeric inputs (Baseline/Target/Realisasi/Unit), the 'KPI' add button and the goal edit/delete icon buttons. Tests must fall back to placeholder text and button index, which is brittle.
Divisi input has no data-testid (had to use dialog input .last).
load()/loadCascade() have no try/catch; a failing GET /organization or /strategy/goals leaves the page stuck on 'Memuat...' with an unhandled promise rejection and no error UI.

issues: Layout, contrast and spacing look good; progress bars and health pills render correctly. No issues found.
Row action icon buttons (edit/key/trash) have no tooltips/aria-labels - icon-only actions are ambiguous for users and screen readers.

action_items: Fix PUT /api/organization: change OrgIn.mission/values to Optional[List[str]] = None so partial updates don't wipe saved mission/values.
Decide + align progress health thresholds (40% currently = Off Track red, spec expected At Risk amber) in both server.py _kpi_progress health mapping and StrategyPage healthPill/healthColor.
Remove dead/duplicated code in POST /api/strategy/goals (line ~824 builds `kpis` with an unreadable double comprehension and is immediately overwritten on the next line).
Extract the duplicated progress formula (_kr_progress / _kpi_progress in server.py, kpiProgress in StrategyPage.jsx) into one shared helper each side.
Split /app/backend/server.py (986 lines) into routers (auth, workspaces, okr/tasks/habits, strategy, admin) - exceeds the 700-line guideline.
Add try/catch + error state to StrategyPage load()/loadCascade().
Add missing data-testid attributes: goal KPI numeric inputs, add-KPI button, goal-edit-{id}/goal-delete-{id}, and division inputs in the user dialogs.
critical_code_review_comments: OrgIn list defaults of [] make PUT /organization destructive for partial payloads - only the frontend's always-full payload hides this.
server.py is 986 lines and mixes auth, workspace, strategy and admin concerns; strategy/admin models are declared after the startup handler, hurting readability.
POST /api/strategy/goals contains dead code: doc['kpis'] is computed twice, the first with a confusing nested list comprehension.
SPV dashboard performs 5 DB round-trips per workspace inside a loop (N+1).

Positive: ObjectId is consistently excluded, password_hash never leaked (verified on /users, /auth/me, /admin/users), require_spv guards all new SPV endpoints (403 verified for anggota on organization PUT, goal POST, /users, /admin/*), self-delete blocked with 400, and user delete correctly cascades workspaces/okrs/tasks/habits/logs/sessions.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (2 low-priority testability gaps)

rca_of_the_issue: PUT /api/organization: OrgIn declares `mission: List[str] = []` and `values: List[str] = []`. update_org filters with `if v is not None`, so an omitted field arrives as an empty list, passes the filter and is written by $set, clearing previously saved data. Repro: PUT {name,vision,mission:[m1],values:[v1]} then PUT {"name":"X"} -> GET returns mission=[] values=[]. Mitigation: Optional[List[str]] = None + exclude_unset. Not user-visible today because StrategyPage always submits the complete form, but any future partial caller (or a direct API consumer) loses data.
